## Void Deck 0.2.9

- Fixes the Home screen's featured-game header overlapping the L1/HOME/LIBRARY/FRIENDS/R1 tabs in Steam Deck Game Mode.
- Clears the Play and Details buttons from the "Recently played" heading on shorter viewports.
- Gives the focused recent-game cover room for its focus ring, so it no longer collides with the heading or buttons.
- Tightens Home spacing and featured-title sizes on short viewports; the 1280×800 layout is unchanged.

**Install / update:** Decky → ⚙ → Developer → *Install Plugin from ZIP*, then select `VoidDeck-v0.2.9.zip` from this release.
